description: This file is a shell script designed for automated network connectivity tests and self-healing actions. It performs ping tests to gateway addresses, configured servers, and DNS resolution, and can trigger corrective actions like resets based on test results.

methods.name: getCorrectiveActionState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of whether corrective actions should be taken, based on syscfg value.

methods.name: calcRandTimetoStartPing
methods.description: Calculates a random sleep time to stagger the start of connectivity checks.

methods.name: removehttp
methods.description: Removes the http or https scheme from a URL, returning just the domain or hostname.

methods.name: runDNSPingTest
methods.description: Performs DNS ping test by resolving a URL and taking corrective action if needed.

methods.name: runPingTest
methods.description: Performs comprehensive ping tests to gateway addresses, servers, and checks connectivity statuses, with potential corrective actions.
